target_text.text: Total GHG emissions correspond to the annual totals reported in CO2 equivalents excluding LULUCF in the latest national GHG inventory. The totals comprise all sectors and gases listed in the CTF table entitled ‘Reporting format for the description of a Party’s nationally determined contribution under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement, including updates'

reference_text.text: Base year: 1990 - During the revision of the first NDC, the calculation of the greenhouse gas inventory and quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes identified the 1990 as the base year. In order to make comparisons with the first and the second NDC and changes in the greenhouse gases (hereinafter: GHG), the GHG emission is expressed compared to 1990. The reference level in 1990 is 12 521 Gg CO2-eq. Time frame and period of implementation in ENDC: 14 April 2021 to 31 December 2030 (2035).

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is The Republic of North Macedonia First NDC (Updated submission), filed 2021-04-16. 66 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (20). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 10.2 MtCO₂e, DS-35 8.1 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 52.4 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 30% to 36% reduction in CO2 emissions from fossil fuels combustion by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed partial. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.51°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.38°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
